voiceoverSegments.line: We start by loading the last 1000 candles, giving the strategy its raw price history to work from.
Next we add a MACD with fast 12, slow 26, and signal 9 to measure momentum and spot crossovers.
We plot the MACD line in a vivid red rgba(239,68,68,1) so it stands out on the chart.
Then we draw the signal line in a bright blue #3b82f6 to complete the MACD display.
Finally we overlay the histogram in the same blue #3b82f6 to visualise the MACD’s momentum.

outro.voiceover: Now the chart shows the MACD line, signal line, and histogram, ready to backtest the strategy.
